title: Bug: Manually Entering U to 3+ DP miscalculates Treatment

comments.body:
Seems the problem has been resolved for units of insulin.
But, the problem remains for carbs.

@old-square-eyes Thanks for reporting this.
I am working on it.  Hopefully it will be fixed soon.

This should be fixed as of the 2025.07.25 release.
Thanks for reporting this and I am sorry it took so long to fix it.
